en: Psalms 94

p.src: 1  LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

en: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
u.src: 1  LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

en: 94:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

en: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
u.src: 2  Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

p.src: 3  LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

en: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
u.src: 3  LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

p.src: 4  They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

en: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
u.src: 4  They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

p.src: 5  They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

en: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.
u.src: 5  They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

p.src: 6  They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

en: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
u.src: 6  They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

p.src: 7  They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

en: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
u.src: 7  They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

en: 94:7 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 8  Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

en: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
u.src: 8  Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

p.src: 9  He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

en: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
u.src: 9  He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

p.src: 10  He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

en: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
u.src: 10  He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

p.src: 11  The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

en: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
u.src: 11  The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

p.src: 12  Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

en: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,
u.src: 12  Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

en: 94:12 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 13  that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

en: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
u.src: 13  that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

p.src: 14  For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

en: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
u.src: 14  For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

p.src: 15  For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

en: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
u.src: 15  For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

p.src: 16  Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
u.src: 16  Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

p.src: 17  Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
u.src: 17  Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

p.src: 18  When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

en: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.
u.src: 18  When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

p.src: 19  In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
u.src: 19  In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

p.src: 20  Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

en: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
u.src: 20  Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

p.src: 21  They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
u.src: 21  They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

p.src: 22  But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

en: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
u.src: 22  But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

p.src: 23  He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

en: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
u.src: 23  He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.
